run_reconstruction: run the dynamic NeRF reconstruction pipeline with TensorVMSplit models for a given dataset and config
run_render_test: render test views and novel camera paths including dolly, zoom, and spiral trajectories from a trained checkpoint
run_export_mesh: export a trained dynamic scene as a PLY mesh file from a saved checkpoint using dense alpha extraction
run_prealign_cameras: prealign predicted camera poses to ground truth poses using Procrustes analysis for 3D similarity transform
run_evaluate_camera_alignment: evaluate camera pose alignment quality by computing rotation and translation errors between aligned and ground truth poses
